name: Aim
describe: A ballistic aim: charge the power, set the angle with the view, wind, a trajectory preview, weapons on a wheel; joins turn games (one acts, the camera follows the shot)
examples: turn-based artillery: angle, power and wind
lob grenades that bounce before they blow
pick a weapon from a wheel, fire, watch it fly

weapons.description: The weapons, each data: {id, label, icon, speed (m/s at full power), gravity (× the part's), wind (× the wind), fuse (s; 0 goes off where it lands), bounces, restitution, radius (blast m), force (throw m/s), damage, crater (× the radius), ammo (-1: unlimited), size, color, prop}

start.description: The weapon each player starts with ("": the first)

chargeSeconds.description: Seconds from no power to full while primary is held

charge.description: Full power holds (clamp) or swings back down (swing)

gravity.description: Gravity on a shell (m/s², × each weapon's)

angleLift.description: Degrees the shot leaves above where the view looks

wind.description: Strongest wind (m/s² sideways on a shell; 0: none)

preview.description: The trajectory preview: the whole arc, its start (previewSeconds), or none

previewSeconds.description: Seconds of flight a short preview shows

cooldown.description: Seconds between one player's shots (real-time games)

follow.description: Whose shots the camera follows: in turn games (turns), your own, everyone's, none

shotsPerTurn.description: Shots a player fires on a turn

holdOthers.description: In a turn game the players whose turn it is not hold still

settleSeconds.description: Seconds after everything has come to rest before the turn passes

lifetime.description: Seconds before a shell that never lands is gone

carveScale.description: Crater radius per metre of blast (with the carve mechanic)

botError.description: How far a bot's aim is off (0 perfect, 0.3 wild)

botThink.description: Seconds a bot thinks before it aims

hud.description: The angle, power and wind dials and the weapon wheel on the kit HUD

explodeFx.description: A vfx preset at each blast as well as the effect style's (blast-puffs, fireball, ...); unset: the style alone

splashFx.description: A vfx preset where a shell lands in the water (water-splash); unset: none

soundFire.description: Sound id when a shell leaves

soundSplash.description: Sound id when a shell lands in the water

textCharge.default: Hold to charge, release to fire
textCharge.description: The hint on the first turn

events.name: onFire
events.args: { shooter, weapon, power, yaw, elevation, point }

events.name: onExplode
events.when: a shell went off (thrown: the bodies the blast threw)

events.name: onTurnDone
events.when: a turn's shot went off and everything came to rest (the turn passes)

host.how: a player's copy sends its aim, power and weapon when it fires; the host flies every shell (wind, bounces, fuse), blasts where it ends and tells everyone; the wind and ammunition are shared

fields.s: [[id, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, weapon, shooter]] shells in flight

owns.why: hold to charge the power, release to fire

bots: aim.bot(p) from rules.bot: solves the shot with the wind, adds an error, charges in view and fires

lines: The part fires by itself on primary (hold to charge, release) for this screen's player; rules.bot calls aim.bot(p) so bots aim and fire too.
A blast throws through the knockback mechanic and carves through the carve mechanic when the game has them; score in their events or aim.onExplode (host).
In a turns game the turn passes by itself once the shot has gone off and everything has settled: never call ctx.turns.done for it.

traps: rules.bot must call aim.bot(p) (or bots never fire)
a blast already throws and carves through the knockback and carve parts: do not do it again in onExplode

signs: checked: gate C (measure 15) judges its sign of life (sample and judge in the implementation)

fixture.missing: no k2 fixture folder: the two-player check is tests/chaos-two-players.mjs <game> (turns over WebRTC: each fires on their own turn, the camera follows the shot)

evidence.what: tests/aim-juice.test.mjs pass; tests/chaos-two-players.mjs: turns over WebRTC with real input (view, F held, release), the camera follows the shot on both screens (11/11); verify 6/6 gates, 22/22 measures
